layout_sources: https://pkg.go.dev/git.sr.ht/~mendelmaleh/pfin/parser/bofa (parser splits the file at the CRLF blank line: a summary table, then Date,Description,Amount,Running Bal.; amounts with thousands commas)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/master/bank2ynab.conf ([US Bank of America]: stmt.csv, Header Rows = 7, Date,Payee,Outflow,skip, %m/%d/%Y)
https://github.com/YoungCatChen/bank-csv-parser/blob/master/csv-examples/bofa.csv (a real 2015 export, amounts scrambled: same summary block, CRLF, oldest first)
https://github.com/VonHoltenCodes/SlowBooks-Pro-2026/pull/130 (2026 "real shape" fixture: summary amounts quoted with thousands commas)
notes: Five summary rows (Description,,Summary Amt. / Beginning balance as of / Total credits / Total debits / Ending balance as of), a blank line, then Date,Description,Amount,Running Bal. The first row under the header is the beginning balance again with an empty Amount: not a line. Oldest first, MM/DD/YYYY, signed amounts in quotes with comma thousands separators (the 2015 sample has none; recent ones do), CRLF. Opening and closing are the summary's beginning and ending balances, and the running balance agrees.
